# Tom Select

Version 2.6.2, downloaded from the official `tom-select` npm package.
Source: https://github.com/orchidjs/tom-select/tree/v2.6.2
Documentation: https://tom-select.js.org/
License: Apache-2.0, included in `tom-select-LICENSE.txt`.

`tom-select-2.6.2.min.js` is the package's `tom-select.base.min.js` bundle.
`tom-select-2.6.2.min.css` is the package's `tom-select.min.css` stylesheet.
Both files are unmodified. They are served locally; dropdown searches use only
publication metadata already loaded by the page and make no external requests.
